        servers.add(srv)

        gpus.add(f\"{srv}:{gpu}\")
print(f'Servers: {sorted(servers)}')
print(f'Server:GPU pairs: {sorted(gpus)}')

# Also show status distribution
from collections import Counter
status_counts = Counter(e.get('status') for e in experiments)
print(f'\\nStatus distribution: {dict(status_counts)}')
"
